description: A painted scene in a dark, wood-paneled study lined with bookshelves. A man with a moustache and round spectacles, in a dark suit, raises his right hand palm forward while his left rests on a desk. Several men in dark suits and period collars stand around him, and light falls through a window with drapes on the right. The clothing and furnishings look late 19th or early 20th century. No text is visible. A gilt-framed picture hangs on the wall at the far upper left, inside the room. The image fills the canvas edge to edge.
